caption: The video captures a low-angle, shallow-focus view of a wet asphalt surface. In the foreground-left lies a dark, irregular puddle whose center-right carries a bright silvery-white reflection. Solid debris sits at the puddle's edge, a small brown nut at left-center and a tiny fragment right of the highlight, while a curved orange-brown husk rests on the mid-right ground. The background is a blurred wooden wall with a dark square panel left and a small green sprout near center. Over time the bright reflection subtly changes, reading as a taller rounded highlight early on and becoming flatter and more horizontally spread. The dark wet contour appears to shift slightly with it, extending a touch toward the right. The foreground asphalt and puddle edges vary a little in apparent sharpness. All solid objects—the husk, the fragments, the sprout, and the panel—remain essentially in place.
relations: The bright puddle reflection flattens and spreads horizontally as time progresses.
The dark wet contour shifts slightly rightward in tandem with the changing highlight.
Foreground asphalt and puddle edges vary a little in apparent sharpness.
Solid debris, husk, sprout, and background panel remain essentially stationary.
